content.title: LOR chahiye?
content.subtitle: Achha LOR achhi planning se aata hai.

steps.title: Sahi insaan chuno
steps.detail: Jo aapko achhe se jaanta ho, wo bade naam se zyada kaam ka hai.

steps.title: Jaldi poocho
steps.detail: Deadline se kaafi pehle request karo. Unke paas bhi baaki kaam hai.

steps.title: Brief bhejo
steps.detail: Resume, course ka naam aur wo projects jo unke saath kiye. Unhe yaad karna aasaan hoga.

steps.title: Process samjhao
steps.detail: Portal ka link kab aayega aur kya bharna hai, pehle se bata do.

steps.title: Thank you bolo
steps.detail: Submit hone ke baad shukriya. Result aaye toh unhe zaroor batao.

caption:
Professor ya manager se LOR maangna awkward lagta hai? Ye 5 steps follow karo 👇

1. Sahi insaan chuno
2. Jaldi poocho
3. Brief bhejo
4. Process samjhao
5. Thank you bolo

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jise iski zaroorat hai.
